about.description: Phoenix IX is a beachfront condo resort located on the eastern end of Orange Beach near the Alabama-Florida border, offering a quieter stretch of sugar-white sand and convenient access to Orange Beach, Perdido Key, and nearby Gulf Shores. The property features spacious 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals, all designed to face the water and include private balconies. Guests enjoy open layouts and scenic vantage points that showcase either Gulf-front or bay views, making Phoenix IX a distinctive option for travelers who value space, scenery, and a more peaceful beachfront location on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
about.elevator_pitch: Phoenix IX offers spacious, water-facing 1-3 bedroom beachfront condos with resort amenities on Orange Beach's quieter eastern end.
